label: D1 after unrewarded S2 visit; stronger after a1 (rare), two losses, early episode
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == -1) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (zero at GO and D2), and only when the previous trial reached S2 and went unrewarded. Dev weights: about +1.12 after a1 S2 u (rare transition) and +0.83 after a2 S2 u (common). On those trials it drops about 0.011 per episode trial, so it fades late in the episode. It gets about +0.50 more when the trial before that was also unrewarded (two losses in a row). Window-first trials with an unknown previous state and no reward get +0.25, a window artifact. After S1 outcomes or rewarded outcomes it sits at zero, below the D1 timing baseline. The model value term (+0.002 dev R^2), the S2 state two trials back, the hidden good state and future variables add little. All terms are observed. Test R^2 beyond timing is about 0.60, above the additive all ceiling of 0.50 because the terms are interactions.

issues: Minor: 'two losses' undersells the effect. It builds over a run of losses: adding U*(reward[-2]==0)*(reward[-3]==0) gets about +0.30 more (dev weight) on top of the +0.42 two-loss term, and test R^2 beyond timing goes from 0.602 to 0.619 with a nonlinear ep_dec term and a first-trial ep_trial term added. Better described as a run of recent losses.

Minor: the a1-over-a2 (rare) advantage is partly carried by the policy. With U*value and U*choice added, the a1 S2 u weight drops from 1.12 to 0.28 and the a2 S2 u weight goes from 0.83 to 0.62 (test 0.633). So 'stronger after a1 (rare)' holds marginally, but much of it moves with the model's choice logit.

The claims check out. With only the two last_is terms, test R^2 beyond timing is 0.370. Adding ep_trial gives 0.498 (weight -0.011). Adding the two-loss term gives 0.442 (weight +0.50). All terms together give 0.602. D1 after any S1 or rewarded outcome has residual about -0.11, and GO/D2 are exactly 0. since_rev, good==2 and S2 two trials back each add 0.002 or less.

Misses show no large systematic class. Mean errors by phase x previous trial are all within 0.09. The worst-fit windows are mostly the window-first D1 (prev_state unknown, actual about 2.3, predicted 0.4), which cannot be fixed from inside the window, as the label says. The rest is within-cell bimodality (the activation is about 0 or about 2 inside S2u cells), which these terms don't resolve.
